gloss: to tighten; to brace; to firm up

forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{締|し}めませんでした

definitions.gloss: to tighten; to pull tight; to firm up
definitions.explanation: To make something physically tighter or more toned, such as muscles or a body.

definitions.gloss: to brace oneself; to tighten discipline; to buckle down
definitions.explanation: To adopt a more serious, focused attitude. Often used about mental or organizational discipline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}めたい。
examples.english: I want to tone my body.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This cream has a skin-tightening effect.

examples.english: A policy to tighten finances was announced ahead of the new fiscal year.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{締|し}める is a transitive ichidan verb. It is a compound of ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) and ⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tighten).

ASPECT (ている):
{引|ひ}き{締|し}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing process of tightening, or a resulting toned/disciplined state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [object]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tighten something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tone one's body)
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to brace oneself, to get serious)
- ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tighten finances)
- ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to set one's expression firmly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{締|し}める: to tighten, to tone (emphasizes pulling tight)
- ⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to tighten, to close (simpler, more general)
- ⟦{緩|ゆる}める→緩める：15263_yurumeru⟧: to loosen (antonym)
